migration_readonly_note: Data Anda telah diekspor ke Fushi. Aplikasi ini sekarang hanya baca: gunakan Fushi untuk membaca dan membuat kartu. Anda bisa mengekspor ulang kapan saja jika Fushi melaporkan data yang hilang.
migration_settings_entry_subtitle: Pindahkan semua data ke aplikasi Fushi yang baru
migration_target_missing: Fushi belum diinstal. Instal Fushi terlebih dahulu, lalu kembali ke sini.
migration_uninstall_prompt: Migrasi selesai. Hapus instalasi aplikasi Hibiki lama?
migration_uninstall_still_installed: Hibiki masih terinstal. Anda bisa menghapus instalasinya kapan saja.
mihon_extension_bulk_install_confirm: Instal ${count} ekstensi dari repositori ini? Ekstensi menjalankan kode dari sumbernya.
mihon_extension_bulk_install_nothing: Semua ekstensi yang cocok dengan filter saat ini sudah terpasang.
mihon_extension_preview_read_only: Pratinjau hanya baca. Instal ekstensi untuk membuka dan membaca.
mihon_extension_preview_warning: Pratinjau menjalankan kode ekstensi ini sebelum diinstal. Tidak ada yang ditambahkan ke perpustakaan Anda sampai Anda memilih untuk menginstal.
mihon_extension_uninstall_confirm_multi: The extension “$name” provides $count sources. Uninstalling it removes all of them:
mihon_extension_uninstall_confirm_single: Uninstall the extension “$name”? Its source will be removed from the source list.
mihon_extension_update_all_confirm: Perbarui ${count} ekstensi terpasang ke versi terbaru di repositorinya?
mihon_extension_update_all_nothing: Semua ekstensi terpasang sudah yang terbaru.
mihon_extension_warning: Ekstensi pihak ketiga menjalankan kode dengan izin Fushi. Hanya instal ekstensi dan penanda tangan yang Anda percayai.
mihon_runtime_unavailable: Ekstensi Mihon tidak tersedia di platform ini.
mihon_source_clear_data_hint: Menghapus preferensi dan cookie sumber ini. Ekstensi yang terinstal dipertahankan.
mihon_source_empty: Tidak ada sumber manga yang aktif. Instal dan aktifkan ekstensi terlebih dahulu.
mihon_source_login_empty: Tidak ada cookie sesi yang ditangkap; tidak ada yang disimpan
mihon_source_login_hint: Masuk di situs, lalu ketuk Selesai untuk menyimpan sesi
mihon_source_login_import_hint: Situs dibuka di browser Anda. Ekstensi Fushi akan mengirim sesinya ke sini; masuk di sana jika perlu, lalu ketuk Selesai.
mihon_source_website_unavailable: Sumber ini tidak memiliki halaman web untuk judul ini
mihon_sources_sort_by_downloads_done: Sumber diurutkan ulang menurut unduhan ekstensi
mihon_sources_sort_by_downloads_no_data: Belum ada jumlah unduhan; segarkan repositori ekstensi dulu
mihon_store_empty: Belum ada repositori ekstensi. Fushi tidak menyertakan satu pun — tambahkan URL indeks repositori yang kompatibel dengan Mihon dan Anda percayai, atau impor APK lokal.
mihon_store_zero_extensions: Repositori ini mengembalikan 0 ekstensi. Alamatnya mungkin menunjuk ke indeks lama.
mining_animated_play_once_hint: Animated card images (GIF / WebP / AVIF) play through once in Anki instead of looping, like video clips. Applies to newly mined cards.
mining_audio_follow_playback_speed: Sesuaikan audio kalimat dengan kecepatan putar
mining_audio_follow_playback_speed_hint: Saat buku audio diputar lebih cepat atau lebih lambat dari 1×, audio kalimat pada kartu direntangkan waktunya ke kecepatan yang sama dengan nada dipertahankan. Hanya untuk mining buku audio.
mining_audio_head_pad_hint: Audio tambahan dipertahankan sebelum subtitel mulai, agar suku kata pertama tidak terpotong. Tidak pernah masuk ke baris sebelumnya.
mining_audio_quality_hint: Bitrate lebih tinggi lebih jernih tetapi membuat kartu lebih besar.
mining_audio_tail_pad_hint: Audio tambahan dipertahankan setelah subtitel berakhir, agar bunyi di akhir tidak terpotong. Tidak pernah masuk ke baris berikutnya.
mining_clip_format_hint: WebM diputar di dalam kartu, tetapi AnkiMobile di iPhone tidak dapat memutarnya — pilih MP4 jika Anda mengulas di iPhone. Jika WebM tidak dapat dienkode di perangkat ini, Fushi beralih ke MP4.
mining_clip_format_mp4_h264: MP4 · H.264 (pemutar Anki sendiri; gunakan untuk AnkiMobile)
mining_clip_format_webm_av1: WebM · AV1 (diputar di dalam kartu; file terkecil, sekitar 2× waktu enkode VP9)
mining_clip_format_webm_vp9: WebM · VP9 (diputar di dalam kartu, direkomendasikan)
mining_image_quality_hint: Lebih tinggi lebih tajam tetapi membuat kartu lebih besar. Maksimum mempertahankan resolusi sumber tangkapan layar; GIF animasi tetap dibatasi agar kartu tetap bisa digunakan.
models_ocr_summary: Shared by manga and graphic subtitles: engine, local models and LLM correction
models_tts_fallback_online_notice: The word is sent to this online service
models_tts_fallback_voice_hint: Voice used to generate word audio when none is found
models_tts_summary: Read-aloud voices, local GPT-SoVITS and the card audio fallback
models_tts_unavailable: No speech engine on this platform
models_tts_usage: Generates word audio for cards only when no local or online audio is found
module_disabled_hint: Modul fitur ini dimatikan di Pengaturan > Tampilan > Modul fitur.
module_downloads_hidden_hint: Tab Jelajah disembunyikan di Pengaturan → Tampilan → Modul fitur; nyalakan lagi untuk mengelola langganan.
music_cd_lookup_none: This disc is not in MusicBrainz; track names come from CD-TEXT or track numbers
music_cd_not_audio: The disc in $device has no audio tracks
music_cd_play_no_disc: No audio CD to read in $device
music_cd_play_other_disc: The disc in $device is not the CD this album was read from
music_cd_read_failed: Could not read the disc in $device (no disc, or not an audio CD)
music_crossfade_continuous_hint: Also crossfade consecutive album tracks and CUE splits, which normally stay gapless.
music_crossfade_disabled_exclusive: Off while exclusive output is on
music_crossfade_hint: Fade between tracks on an equal-power curve. Gapless album tracks and CUE splits stay gapless. Not bit-perfect; turned off automatically with exclusive output.
music_desktop_lyrics_hint: Show the current lyric line in a floating always-on-top window while music plays
music_disc_bluray_image_unsupported: Chapter import from Blu-ray images (.iso) is not supported yet; use the disc folder
music_disc_choose_titles_hint: Each chapter of the chosen titles becomes a track.
music_disc_lookup_hint: Searches DVD and Blu-ray releases by title and matches them by track count and length.
music_disc_lookup_none: No release with a matching track list was found
music_disc_no_chapters: No chapters could be read from the chosen titles
music_disc_none_found: No DVD or Blu-ray found in that folder
music_disc_remove_confirm: Remove this disc from the music library? Files on disk are not touched.
music_disc_unreadable: Not a readable DVD or Blu-ray: $path
music_eq_enabled_hint: 10-band graphic EQ with automatic headroom. While it changes the signal the output is not bit-perfect; off or flat adds no filter.
music_eq_on: On — playback is no longer bit-perfect
music_exclusive_hint: Bypass the system mixer so the DAC gets the source samples unchanged. Other apps are silent while music plays.
music_folder_duplicate: This folder is already a music source
music_gapless_hint: Preload the next track so albums play without gaps
music_karaoke_ass_render_hint: How ASS lyrics show in the karaoke view. Automatic renders subtitles with effects as authored and plain karaoke timing as synced lyrics
music_karaoke_effects_hint: These subtitles have karaoke effects that look best rendered as authored
music_karaoke_open_failed: Could not open the karaoke view
music_library_empty_hint: Add a folder that holds your music files.
music_listening_study_hint: When off, only listening after a lookup, card or loop on the lyrics page counts
music_loudness_scan_hint: EBU R128 scan in the background. Results are stored in the library; your files are not modified.
music_lyrics_ab_loop_extend: Add the next line to the loop
music_lyrics_export_ttml: Export TTML next to the audio file
music_lyrics_media_session_hint: Show the current line as the subtitle of the media notification and lock screen
music_lyrics_online_hint: When no local lyrics exist, match title, artist, album and duration on LRCLIB
music_output_fallback_device: The selected output device is unavailable, using the system default
music_output_fallback_exclusive: Exclusive output is unavailable, switched to shared mode
music_replaygain_hint: Album gain when playing an album in order, track gain otherwise
music_scrape_acoustid_off: AcoustID fingerprinting is off: no application API key (Settings › Music)
music_scrape_not_matched: No confident match — choose one manually
music_server_allow_http_hint: Only for servers on your own network; credentials travel unencrypted
music_server_bitrate_hint: Original plays the file as stored (lossless stays lossless); a cap asks the server to transcode
music_server_field_api_key_hint: OpenSubsonic API key; replaces username and password when the server supports it
music_server_jellyfin_subtitle: Jellyfin / Emby · show in music library
music_server_load_failed: Could not load from the server
music_server_remove_confirm: Remove $name? Its saved credentials are deleted from this device.
music_servers_empty_hint: Sign in to Jellyfin / Emby in Settings › Services, or add an OpenSubsonic server in Settings › Music.
music_servers_settings_hint: Jellyfin / Emby servers you signed in to for video are listed here; add OpenSubsonic servers (Navidrome and others) below. Turn a server on to show its albums in the music library.
music_setting_acoustid_key_builtin_hint: Built in; enter your own AcoustID application key to override it. Only the fingerprint and duration are sent.
music_setting_acoustid_key_hint: Application key from acoustid.org. Without it, fingerprint identification is off; only the fingerprint and duration are sent.
music_setting_identify_library_hint: MusicBrainz, at most one request per second
music_setting_vgmdb_hint: Community mirror without an official API; queried slowly, by catalog number only
music_signal_path_dac_volume_hint: Bit-perfect output: adjust the volume on your DAC
music_signal_path_ios_mixer: iOS has no exclusive mode; output goes through the system mixer
music_tag_writeback_cue: CUE tracks share one file, so tags can't be written per track
music_tag_writeback_hint: Unchecked fields keep their current value and won't be suggested again.
music_tag_writeback_unreadable: Could not read this file's tags
music_theme_song_detect_partial: Found in $hits episodes; $failed files could not be read
music_works_empty: Songs grouped by anime, game and film works appear here once works are linked.
name: Nama
network_proxy_address_hint: Server proxy HTTP yang dipakai semua permintaan internet publik
network_proxy_auto_hint: Berlaku untuk semua permintaan Internet aplikasi: pembaruan, sinkronisasi cloud, kamus, unduhan, subtitel, dan metadata. Kosongkan untuk otomatis: variabel lingkungan, lalu proksi sistem yang diaktifkan. Transfer P2P (torrent) terhubung langsung secara default; Anda dapat mengaktifkannya secara terpisah di bawah.
network_proxy_credentials_scope_hint: Kredensial hanya berlaku untuk permintaan HTTP; mesin torrent bawaan tidak dapat menggunakannya
network_proxy_mode_auto_hint: Gunakan variabel lingkungan, lalu proxy sistem yang aktif
network_proxy_mode_manual_hint: Gunakan server dan kredensial opsional di bawah
network_proxy_p2p_warning: Langsung secara default. Lewat proksi: semua lalu lintas P2P melewati proksi global — kecepatan bisa turun, dan banyak penyedia proksi melarang lalu lintas BitTorrent (pembatasan kecepatan, peringatan, atau penutupan akun). Campuran: permintaan tracker melewati proksi sedangkan koneksi DHT dan peer tetap langsung — penemuan peer paling luas, tetapi IP asli Anda terlihat oleh tracker, DHT, dan peer (hanya untuk konektivitas, bukan privasi). Hanya berlaku untuk mesin bawaan; qBittorrent eksternal memakai pengaturan proksinya sendiri.
no_audio_file: Tidak ada file audio untuk disimpan.
no_collections: Tidak ada bookmark atau kalimat tersimpan
novel_detail_library_remove_confirm: Hapus novel ini dari rak buku? Bab yang tersimpan dan progres membaca akan dihapus.
novel_download_range_hint: Bab $from–$to ($count) akan disimpan ke rak buku Anda sebagai satu EPUB.
novel_online_chapter_pending: Bab ini belum dimuat. Periksa koneksi Anda, lalu buka ulang bab untuk memuatnya dari sumber.
novel_online_sources_empty: Belum ada sumber novel. Pasang plugin di Ekstensi dulu.
novel_online_sources_hint: Plugin LNReader pihak ketiga. Konten berasal dari situs web sumber; novel yang diunduh disimpan ke rak buku Anda sebagai EPUB.
novel_source_clear_data_hint: Menghapus data yang disimpan plugin ini (seperti token). Plugin tetap terpasang.
novel_store_add_warning: Plugin LNReader adalah skrip pihak ketiga yang mengambil konten dari situs web. Tambahkan hanya repositori yang Anda percayai.
novel_store_empty: Belum ada repositori plugin. Fushi tidak menyertakan satu pun — tambahkan URL indeks repositori plugin LNReader yang Anda percayai.
novel_web_chapter_pending: The next chapter is fetched from the website when you reach this page. If it doesn't load, open the original page in the Fushi browser once, then come back.
novel_web_extract_empty: No novel chapter text was found on this page
novel_web_preview_merge: Adds to “$title” on your shelf ($count chapters so far).
novel_web_preview_new: Adds a new book to your shelf.
novel_web_preview_next_found: Next chapter found. It is fetched automatically when you reach the end.
novel_web_preview_next_missing: No next-chapter link was found on this page.
ocr_llm_default_body: Text boxes the OCR isn't sure about will be cropped and sent to ${provider} to re-read, billed by that provider. The local OCR result and nearby text go along to help it decide. You can change this anytime in Settings › Models › OCR.
ocr_llm_default_title: Let an LLM fix uncertain OCR?
ocr_system_model_downloading: Downloading through Google Play services… You can close this dialog; the download continues in the background.
ocr_system_model_missing: Google Play services hasn't downloaded the text recognition model yet. Download it now (a few MB) to use screen OCR.
ocr_system_model_play_services_resolvabl: System OCR needs Google Play services, which is missing, disabled or outdated on this device.
ocr_system_model_play_services_unavailab: This device has no usable Google Play services, so system OCR can't run here.
ocr_system_model_ready: The text recognition model is ready. Try OCR again.
onboarding_anki_action_get_anki_desc: Membuka halaman unduh Anki. Biarkan Anki tetap berjalan selagi Anda membuat kartu.
onboarding_anki_action_get_ankidroid_des: Membuka halaman toko. Fushi menulis kartu ke AnkiDroid, jadi harus dipasang lebih dulu.
onboarding_anki_action_install_addon_des: Mengekstrak add-on AnkiConnect bawaan ke dalam Anki. Mulai ulang Anki setelahnya.
onboarding_anki_action_refresh_desc: Memuat ulang dek dan jenis catatan. Gunakan setelah membuat dek di Anki.
onboarding_anki_action_test_desc: Memeriksa apakah Fushi bisa menghubungi Anki dan memuat dek serta jenis catatan Anda. Tidak membuat apa pun.
onboarding_anki_addon_installed: AnkiConnect terpasang. Jalankan atau mulai ulang Anki, lalu tes koneksinya.
onboarding_anki_addon_no_anki: Folder data Anki tidak ditemukan. Pasang Anki, buka sekali, lalu coba lagi.
onboarding_anki_auto_reposition_hint: About 30 seconds after you mine, new cards in that deck are reordered by word frequency so common words come first. Review cards are never touched. Needs desktop Anki with AnkiConnect (a phone can use it by connecting to AnkiConnect on a computer); AnkiDroid and AnkiMobile can't reorder cards.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_body: Anki memiliki FSRS bawaan · salah satu algoritma pengulangan berjarak terbaik · tetapi tetap menjadwalkan dengan SM-2 dari tahun 1980-an sampai Anda mengaktifkan FSRS. FSRS membaca riwayat ulasan asli Anda dan memprediksi kapan Anda akan lupa, sehingga retensi tetap sama dengan ulasan lebih sedikit. Anda mengaktifkan sakelar ini sekali, di dalam Anki; tidak ada yang berubah di sisi Fushi.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_srs_note: Fushi's built-in review already uses FSRS-7 by default. You only need the steps below if you also review in Anki.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_step_optimize_desc: Tekan Optimalkan di bawah sakelar untuk menyesuaikan parameter dengan riwayat ulasan Anda sendiri, lalu simpan. Di bawah sekitar 1000 ulasan, nilai default sudah mengungguli SM-2, jadi optimalkan lagi setelah Anda belajar beberapa waktu.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_step_options_deskto: Di Anki, klik roda gigi di samping dek dan pilih Opsi.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_step_options_mobile: Di AnkiDroid (2.17 atau lebih baru) atau AnkiMobile, tekan lama dek dan pilih Opsi.
onboarding_anki_fsrs_step_toggle_desc: Gulir ke bagian FSRS di bawah halaman opsi (versi lama menyembunyikannya di bawah Lanjutan) dan aktifkan sakelarnya. Ini berlaku untuk seluruh koleksi Anda, jadi cukup sekali.
onboarding_anki_intro_body: Anki adalah aplikasi kartu hafalan gratis dengan pengulangan berjarak. Setelah pencarian, Fushi mengubah kata itu menjadi kartu berisi arti, kalimat, audio, dan tangkapan layar dalam satu ketukan.
onboarding_anki_mobile_ankiconnect_hint: Buat kartu ke Anki di komputer dalam jaringan yang sama: aktifkan AnkiConnect di pengaturan pembuatan kartu dan masukkan alamat komputernya.
onboarding_anki_mobile_ankiconnect_title: Lanjutan: gunakan AnkiConnect dari perangkat ini
onboarding_anki_setup_android_hint: Pasang AnkiDroid dan buka sekali. Pada kartu pertama, ketuk Izinkan di dialog izin — tidak ada lagi yang perlu diatur.
onboarding_anki_setup_desktop_hint: Pasang Anki, tambahkan add-on AnkiConnect (satu ketukan di bawah, atau kode add-on 2055492159), dan biarkan Anki berjalan selagi Anda membuat kartu.
onboarding_anki_setup_ios_hint: Dengan AnkiMobile terpasang, kartu langsung ditambahkan. Untuk fitur lengkap, hubungkan ke Anki di komputer dalam jaringan yang sama lewat AnkiConnect.
onboarding_click_lookup_intro: Ketuk kata mana pun di buku, manga, atau takarir untuk melihat artinya. Coba dulu pada kalimat latihan di bawah.
onboarding_click_lookup_mine_body: Ketuk + pada entrinya untuk mengirim kata, kalimat, audio, dan gambar ke pembuat kartu.
onboarding_click_lookup_nested_body: Ketuk kata di dalam definisi untuk turun satu tingkat. Tekan kembali atau ketuk di luar untuk menutup satu tingkat.
onboarding_click_lookup_tap_desc: Ketuk satu karakter (atau klik kiri di komputer); Fushi mengambil kata terpanjang yang dimulai di situ. Kalimatnya terbuka di halaman pencarian.
onboarding_click_lookup_unified_style_de: Dictionaries keep their own colors by default. To recolor their tags, emphasized words and borders with your theme accent, turn on "Unify dictionary styles" in the lookup settings.
onboarding_feature_backup_hint: Google Drive, WebDAV, atau berkas lokal
onboarding_feature_books_hint: Baca EPUB dengan pencarian kata dan sinkronisasi buku audio
onboarding_feature_browse_hint: Sumber online, ekstensi, penemuan, dan unduhan
onboarding_feature_fonts_hint: Pakai font Anda sendiri untuk antarmuka, teks buku, dan kamus
onboarding_feature_interconnect_hint: Bagikan perpustakaan dan progres antarperangkat di LAN Anda
onboarding_feature_manual_resources_hint: Kamus, buku audio, dan sumber pelafalan dari berkas Anda sendiri
onboarding_feature_pack_hint: Kamus Jepang plus audio pengucapan JA/EN dalam satu unduhan
onboarding_feature_review_hint: Turn lookups into cards and choose where to review them
onboarding_feature_video_hint: Pencarian pada takarir dan pembuatan kartu
onboarding_feature_web_basic_hint: Browse sites inside Fushi and look up words on any page.
onboarding_feature_web_hint: Browse sites inside Fushi: watch video sites in the Fushi player, read web comics in the Fushi reader, and look up words on any page. Desktop can also install the browser extension.
onboarding_feature_web_reader_desktop_hi: Browse sites inside Fushi: read web comics and web novels in the Fushi reader, and look up words on any page. Desktop can also install the browser extension.
onboarding_feature_web_reader_hint: Browse sites inside Fushi: read web comics and web novels in the Fushi reader, and look up words on any page.
onboarding_features_modules_hint: Halaman yang tidak dicentang disembunyikan dari bilah navigasi. Bisa diubah kapan saja di Pengaturan → Tampilan.
onboarding_features_setup_hint: Hanya item yang dicentang yang mendapat langkah di panduan ini.
onboarding_finish_body: Anda bisa membuka lagi panduan ini kapan saja dari Pengaturan → Sistem.
onboarding_finish_import_desc: On the Review page, tap Import in the top bar and pick an .apkg or .colpkg file exported from Anki.
onboarding_finish_review_desc: Cards you make land on the Review tab; cards that are due wait for you there.
onboarding_first_anki_action_desc: Membuka kalimat latihan di halaman pencarian. Ketuk sebuah kata, ketuk +, periksa kolomnya, lalu simpan.
onboarding_first_anki_card_intro: Anki sudah tersambung. Buat satu kartu sungguhan sekarang supaya Anda tahu seluruh alurnya jalan.
onboarding_first_anki_lookup_desc: Buka kalimat latihan lalu ketuk sebuah kata.
onboarding_first_anki_plus_body: Pembuat kartu terbuka dengan kata, cara baca, arti, kalimat, audio, dan gambar sudah terisi.
onboarding_first_anki_save_body: Pastikan dek dan jenis catatannya, lalu simpan. Buka Anki untuk melihat kartunya.
onboarding_global_lookup_android_body: Android menyerahkan teks yang dipilih ke Fushi lewat menu teks atau panel Bagikan.
onboarding_global_lookup_android_continu: Pencarian terbuka di atas aplikasi lain. Tutup untuk kembali.
onboarding_global_lookup_android_open_bo: Ketuk Fushi di menu pemilihan, atau ketuk Bagikan lalu pilih Fushi.
onboarding_global_lookup_android_select_: Tekan lama sebuah kata di aplikasi lain, lalu geser pegangannya sampai menutupi kata itu.
onboarding_global_lookup_windows_action_: Hanya kalau Anda ingin kombinasi tombol lain.
onboarding_global_lookup_windows_body: Pilih teks di aplikasi mana pun lalu panggil kamus tanpa berpindah jendela.
onboarding_global_lookup_windows_select_: Sorot sebuah kata di aplikasi mana pun dan biarkan tetap terpilih.
onboarding_global_lookup_windows_shortcu: Fushi mengambil teks yang dipilih dan membuka kartu pencarian di dekat kursor.
onboarding_lookup_practice_desc: Membuka halaman pencarian dengan kalimat sudah dimuat. Ketuk sebuah kata di sana untuk melihat artinya; kalau tidak ada hasil, kamus Anda belum terpasang.
onboarding_manual_audiobook_action_desc: Buku atau teks, takarir yang selaras, dan berkas audio. Takarirlah yang membuat Fushi bisa menyelaraskan audio per kalimat.
onboarding_manual_dictionary_action_desc: Membuka manajemen kamus. Pencarian baru memberi hasil setelah ada kamus yang terpasang.
onboarding_manual_pronunciation_action_d: Sumber lokal atau daring untuk pelafalan kata di entri kamus. Berbeda dari audio buku audio.
onboarding_online_services_anidb: Identifikasi anime dan episode dengan sidik jari berkas. Fushi memiliki klien aplikasi terdaftar; Anda tetap memerlukan akun AniDB sendiri. Masukkan akun di pengaturan dan aktifkan identifikasi hash berkas bila diinginkan.
onboarding_online_services_body: Atur hanya layanan yang diperlukan, atau lewati langkah ini. Memilih tutorial ini tidak mengaktifkan layanan atau mengirim kredensial, dan tidak memilihnya tidak mengubah pengaturan yang sudah ada.
onboarding_online_services_build_missing: Kredensial aplikasi tidak tersedia dalam build ini
onboarding_online_services_dandanplay: Build ini menyertakan kredensial aplikasi layanan danmaku. Pengguna tidak perlu mengajukan akses API; aktifkan pencocokan danmaku daring bila diinginkan.
onboarding_online_services_dandanplay_mi: Build ini tidak menyertakan kredensial aplikasi danmaku, sehingga pencocokan daring resmi tidak tersedia. Pengembang menyediakan kredensial ini; Anda tidak perlu mendaftarkan API pribadi.
onboarding_online_services_hint: Pelajari akun, kunci API, dan layanan yang tersedia
onboarding_online_services_jimaku: Cari takarir. Daftar atau masuk ke Jimaku, buat kunci API pribadi di halaman akun, lalu masukkan di pengaturan dan aktifkan sumber takarir ini.
onboarding_online_services_opensubtitles: Cari dan unduh takarir. Daftarkan akun, buat konsumen API, dan dapatkan kunci API. Login pengguna bersifat opsional dan menggunakan kuota unduhan akun tersebut.
Kunci API aplikasi sudah disertakan. Anda dapat memilih untuk masuk ke akun OpenSubtitles sendiri guna memakai kuota unduhan pribadi, atau menggunakan kunci API sendiri.
onboarding_online_services_public: MAL / Jikan menyediakan metadata; AniList mendukung penemuan dan pencarian terkait. Kueri publik hanya-baca tidak memerlukan akun pribadi atau kunci API.
onboarding_online_services_servers: Layanan ini tidak memiliki halaman pendaftaran bersama. Masukkan alamat server yang sudah Anda miliki beserta akun atau kunci dari administratornya, atau lewati jika tidak memiliki server.
onboarding_online_services_subdl: Temukan subtitel bahasa Inggris dan multibahasa untuk film dan TV. Daftar akun SubDL gratis, buat kunci API di panel, lalu masukkan di pengaturan dan aktifkan sumber subtitel ini.
onboarding_online_services_tmdb: Build ini menyertakan kunci TMDB untuk metadata cadangan dan kolom yang belum terisi. Tambahkan kunci sendiri hanya jika ingin menggunakan kuota sendiri.
onboarding_online_services_tmdb_missing: Build ini tidak menyertakan kunci TMDB. Ajukan kunci API dan masukkan di pengaturan jika memerlukan TMDB sebagai sumber metadata cadangan; MAL / Jikan tetap tersedia.
onboarding_pack_action_audio_desc: Tambahkan sumber pelafalan daring untuk bahasa yang tidak dicakup paket ini.
onboarding_pack_action_dictionary_desc: Belajar bahasa lain? Impor kamusnya di sini saja.
onboarding_pack_action_download_desc: Mengunduh dari beberapa sumber sekaligus di latar belakang, lalu mengimpornya. Bisa dibatalkan kapan saja; dilanjutkan dari titik terakhir.
onboarding_pack_action_import_existing_d: Paketnya sudah ada di disk. Pilih «Gabungkan» pada dialog konfirmasi agar data Anda yang lama tetap utuh.
onboarding_pack_action_pick_desc: Sudah punya zip paketnya? Impor dari disk dan lewati unduhannya.
onboarding_pack_action_website_desc: Tautan per potongan untuk pengelola unduhan. Setelah itu kembali dan gunakan «Pilih berkas paket».
onboarding_pack_discard_confirm: Unduhan parsial di disk akan dihapus. Mengunduh lagi nanti akan dimulai dari nol.
onboarding_pack_discard_failed: Tidak dapat menghapus file yang diunduh. Tutup aplikasi apa pun yang menggunakannya, lalu coba lagi.
onboarding_pack_download_background_hint: Unduhan terus berjalan di latar belakang · Anda dapat lanjut ke langkah berikutnya atau menutup panduan ini. Progres, pembatalan, dan impor ada di Pengaturan · Sistem.
onboarding_pack_download_finished: Paket yang direkomendasikan selesai diunduh. Impor dari Pengaturan › Sistem.
onboarding_pack_download_ready_hint: Impor paket untuk menggunakan kamus dan sumber pelafalannya. Anda dapat melakukannya nanti.
onboarding_pack_download_ready_notice: Paket yang direkomendasikan diunduh. Pilih Impor sekarang di bilah bawah saat Anda siap.
onboarding_pack_downloading: Mengunduh… batalkan kapan saja dan lanjutkan nanti
onboarding_pack_intro: Kamus Jepang, aksen nada, frekuensi kata, dan audio pengucapan JA/EN dalam satu unduhan. Belajar bahasa lain? Lewati ini dan impor kamus Anda sendiri.
onboarding_pack_paused_desc: Progres disimpan di disk · melanjutkan akan meneruskan dari titik terhenti.
onboarding_pack_pick_failed: Tidak dapat menggunakan file yang dipilih: ${message}
onboarding_pack_pick_no_path: Sistem tidak memberikan path untuk file tersebut. Pindahkan paket ke penyimpanan perangkat dan pilih lagi, atau berikan akses ke semua file.
onboarding_pack_tutorial_desc: Coba cari kata dengan kamus dan sumber pelafalan baru Anda.
onboarding_permission_notifications_desc: Progres unduhan, bab dan episode baru, serta pengingat pembaruan.
onboarding_permission_overlay_desc: Bola mengambang, kamus mengambang, dan lirik mengambang di luar aplikasi.
onboarding_permission_storage_desc: Memindai folder video, manga, dan buku lokal berdasarkan jalur aslinya.
onboarding_review_anki_desc: Send cards to Anki (AnkiDroid, AnkiMobile, or desktop Anki with AnkiConnect) and review them there. The next step connects Anki and picks a deck and note type.
onboarding_review_fushi_auto_reposition_: About 30 seconds after you mine, new cards in that deck are reordered by word frequency so common words come first. Review cards are never touched. You can change this later in Settings › Card creation.
onboarding_review_fushi_desc: Built-in spaced repetition, scheduled with RWKV by default (a small model downloaded on first use). No Anki to install and nothing to set up — the cards you make go straight into review.
onboarding_review_method_body: Cards you make from lookups are reviewed here. You can change this anytime in Settings → Card creation.
onboarding_sample_sentence_hint: Ketuk untuk membukanya di halaman pencarian, lalu ketuk kata mana pun.
onboarding_skip_confirm_desc: Panduan ini menyiapkan kamus, buku pertama, dan pembuatan kartu. Anda dapat membukanya lagi kapan saja dari kartu di beranda atau di Pengaturan › Sistem.
onboarding_srs_action_desc: Add your first card from the deck list
onboarding_srs_body: Review the cards you make right inside Fushi — no Anki needed, nothing to set up.
onboarding_srs_builtin_desc: A default deck and the Fushi Card note type are already set up.
onboarding_srs_fsrs_desc: Scheduling uses FSRS-7, one of the best spaced-repetition algorithms, and adjusts to your own review history.
onboarding_srs_mining_desc: Cards you make while reading or watching can go straight into review.
onboarding_srs_sync_desc: Your decks and review progress follow you to your other devices.
onboarding_step_anki_action_desc: Templat, pemetaan kolom, tangkapan layar, dan audio. Dek dan jenis catatan di atas sudah cukup untuk mulai.
onboarding_step_backup_action_desc: Pilih backend dan masuk, atau ekspor berkas cadangan lokal.
onboarding_step_backup_body: Jaga pustaka Anda tetap aman saat ganti atau kehilangan perangkat.
onboarding_step_extension_action_desc: Menunjukkan cara memasang ekstensi dan menghubungkannya ke Fushi.
onboarding_step_extension_body: Cari kata di halaman web mana pun dengan ekstensi pendamping.
onboarding_step_fonts_action_desc: Impor berkas font dan pilih satu untuk tiap bahasa.
onboarding_step_fonts_body: Pakai font Anda sendiri untuk antarmuka, teks buku, dan kamus.
onboarding_step_interconnect_action_desc: Aktifkan interkoneksi dan pasangkan perangkat ini dengan perangkat Anda yang lain.
onboarding_step_interconnect_body: Pasangkan perangkat di LAN Anda untuk berbagi satu pustaka dan menyelaraskan progres.
onboarding_step_manual_resources_body: Impor minimal satu kamus sebelum tutorial pencarian. Buku audio dan audio pelafalan sifatnya opsional.
onboarding_step_permissions_body: Android menonaktifkan beberapa izin ini secara default. Aktifkan yang Anda perlukan saja; Anda bisa mengubahnya nanti di pengaturan sistem.
onboarding_welcome_body: Pilih bahasa antarmuka dan temanya. Beberapa langkah berikutnya menyiapkan sisanya.
online_source_error_network: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
online_source_error_timeout: The source took too long to respond.
online_source_error_webview_unavailable: This source needs a built-in browser (WebView), which the desktop app doesn't support yet.
overlay_lookup_independent_size_hint: Berikan jendela pencarian pop-out eksternal aplikasi ukuran maksimumnya sendiri alih-alih mengikuti popup dalam aplikasi
page_turn_follow_drag_description: The page moves with your finger; release past a quarter of the width or flick to turn, otherwise it springs back
pdf_no_text_layer: PDF ini tidak memiliki lapisan teks (gambar pindaian), jadi pencarian tidak tersedia.
pdf_outline_empty: PDF ini tidak memiliki daftar isi.
person_bridge_checking: Looking up this person on Wikidata…
person_bridge_failed: Could not reach Wikidata; showing what is known locally.
person_empty: Nothing by this person in your library.
person_songs_empty: No tracks sung by this person in your music library yet. Character songs show up here once tracks carry vocalist credits.
plex_pin_link_hint: Jika browser tidak terbuka, salin tautan ini:
plex_pin_waiting: Menunggu Anda menyetujui Fushi di browser…
plex_servers_none_reachable: Tidak ditemukan server Plex yang dapat dijangkau untuk akun ini.
plex_settings_hint: Masuk dengan akun Plex Anda, atau sambungkan ke server dengan alamat dan X-Plex-Token. Pemutaran men-stream file asli (direct play); transkode Plex tidak digunakan.
popup_advanced_mining_audio_range_hint: The range follows the selected sentences
popup_advanced_mining_crop_hint: Drag on the page to draw a new box · Tab switches panels · arrow keys nudge
popup_advanced_mining_crop_no_model: The panel model is not downloaded, so the box is preselected around the text.
popup_advanced_mining_deck_overwrite_hin: Updating an existing card keeps it in its current deck
popup_advanced_mining_deck_set_default: Also make it the default deck
popup_advanced_mining_deck_unavailable: Connect to Anki to choose a deck
popup_advanced_mining_image_clip_needs_a: A video clip needs sentence audio
popup_advanced_mining_mosaic_forces_stil: With mosaic, the card uses a still screenshot instead of an animation or clip
popup_advanced_mining_mosaic_hint: Drag on the image to mask an area
popup_advanced_mining_sentence_shortcut_: Shortcuts: [ / ] add or remove previous · Shift+[ / ] add or remove next
popup_advanced_mining_still_stale: This is the screen when the dialog opened, not the scene at that line
popup_auto_expand_dictionaries_hint: Pertahankan N baris pertama blok kamus terbuka meskipun 'Ciutkan kamus' aktif. Jumlah yang diperluas mengikuti pengaturan kolom: baris x kolom (0 = ciutkan semua)
popup_bottom_docked_books_only_hint: Pin the lookup popup to the bottom of the screen while reading novels. Manga, video and games keep their current behavior.
popup_bottom_docked_hint: Sematkan popup pencarian sebagai panel selebar layar di bagian bawah, bukan mengikuti kata yang dicari.
popup_compact_glossaries_hint: Tampilkan entri glosarium kamus sebaris, dipisahkan oleh ' | ', bukan satu per baris di popup pencarian.
popup_ctx_confirm_failed: Mining tidak dimulai - popup pencarian tertutup sebelum kartu dapat dibuat. Coba lagi.
popup_ctx_preview_unavailable: Tidak ada audio untuk kalimat ini
popup_ctx_sentence_remove: Remove this sentence from the card
popup_dictionary_max_columns_hint: Isi otomatis hingga sebanyak ini kolom kamus per baris; layar lebih sempit menggunakan lebih sedikit
popup_dismiss_animation_hint: Putar animasi geser keluar saat popup pencarian ditutup dengan menggeser. Matikan untuk menutup instan (selalu mati dalam mode e-ink).
popup_instant_scroll_hint: Pindahkan popup pencarian dengan jarak tetap tanpa animasi gulir untuk layar e-ink.
popup_instant_scroll_touch_step_hint: Seberapa jauh jari harus menggeser sebelum popup melompat satu langkah, sebagai bagian dari tingginya.
popup_instant_scroll_wheel_step_hint: Seberapa jauh satu putaran roda mouse melompatkan popup, sebagai bagian dari tingginya (juga diskalakan oleh kecepatan gulir popup).
popup_mine_overwrite_queued: Will overwrite once saved to Anki.
popup_mine_still_queued: Still saving to Anki. Try again shortly.
popup_mining_target_empty: No profiles or decks yet. Connect Anki in settings first.
popup_mining_target_switch_failed: Could not switch the mining target: $error
popup_wheel_speed_hint: Kecepatan gulir roda mouse untuk popup kamus (juga berlaku untuk ekstensi browser).
profile_language_bindings_hint: Berlaku saat bahasa konten item ditetapkan. Buku EPUB membacanya dari file; untuk format lain, tetapkan pada item itu sendiri.
reader_audiobook_empty_hint: Import audio to listen along with this book
reader_bookmarks_empty: No bookmarks yet. Bookmark a page to jump back to it later.
reader_content_timeout: Pemuatan konten habis waktu. Buka ulang jika tampilan tidak normal
reader_control_editor_drag_hint: Drag a button (long-press on touch) to reorder it or move it to another area. With a keyboard, press Enter on a button to choose where it goes. Changes apply right away.
reader_control_editor_hint: Seret tombol antara bilah atas dan bawah, atau hapus.
reader_control_layout_reset_confirm: Reset the control layout to default? Your customized arrangement will be lost.
reader_control_reject_required: Tombol wajib harus tetap ada di pembaca.
reader_control_reject_title: Judul buku hanya muat di tengah atas; tidak ada yang lain di sana.
reader_control_reset_layout: Pulihkan tata letak tombol pembaca default
reader_control_zone_overflow_hint: Tucked into the ⋯ menu, still available
reader_gallery_empty: Tidak ada ilustrasi di buku ini
reader_gallery_locked_blur_hint: Pengaburan gambar aktif; ungkap untuk melihat
reader_gallery_position_jump: Lompat ke posisi membaca saat ini
reader_highlight_animate_audio_hint: Menggambar setiap kalimat di sepanjang teks saat audio sampai ke kalimat itu
reader_highlight_animate_hint: Menggambar goresan di sepanjang teks saat Anda menambahkan favorit
reader_highlight_animate_lookup_hint: Menggambar goresan saat Anda memilih kata baru; memperluas pilihan dengan menyeret tidak menggambar ulang
reader_highlight_animate_search_hint: Menggambar goresan saat Anda melompat ke hasil baru
reader_highlight_cover_ruby_hint: Menebalkan goresan ke arah furigana. Furigana tetap terbaca di atasnya.
reader_highlight_eink_notice: Mode E-ink selalu memakai gaya klasik.
reader_highlight_preview_color_hint: Hanya mengubah pratinjau. Setiap favorit tetap memakai warnanya sendiri.
reader_highlight_style_classic_hint: Bilah setinggi satu karakter dengan garis bawah
reader_highlight_style_crayon_hint: Warna berbintik dengan tepi tidak rata
reader_highlight_style_fluo_hint: Tepi meluber, lebih gelap di kedua ujung
reader_highlight_style_marker_hint: Ujung miring, dengan sedikit tinta menumpuk saat pena diangkat
reader_highlight_style_rough_hint: Dua goresan bertumpuk, seperti ditandai dua kali
reader_highlight_style_tape_hint: Ujung sobek dan pola diagonal halus
reader_highlight_style_under_hint: Hanya menutup separuh bawah teks, tidak pernah menutup furigana
reader_image_save_denied: Photo library access was denied. Allow it in system settings to save images.
reader_merge_image_pages: Gabung halaman ilustrasi ke dalam teks
reader_merge_image_pages_subtitle: Bab gambar tunggal yang berdiri sendiri dirender di dalam bab teks yang berdekatan alih-alih di halaman sendiri
reader_nav_favorites_empty: No favorite sentences in this book yet
reader_nav_search_empty_hint: Search the whole book, or jump to a character position
reader_not_bound_cannot_rematch: Buku audio tidak terikat ke buku, tidak dapat mencocokkan ulang
reader_page_crease_subtitle: Beri bayangan di celah antara dua halaman, seperti buku terbuka (dua kolom per halaman)
reader_panel_lyrics_exit_hint: Return to the book page at the current sentence
reader_panel_lyrics_switch_hint: Show the audiobook as lyrics that scroll with playback
reader_panel_preview_sample: 吾輩は猫である。名前はまだ無い。どこで生れたかとんと見当がつかぬ。
reader_popup_scroll_dismiss_hint: Dalam mode gulir, terus gulir halaman (teks horizontal atau vertikal) untuk menutup popup pencarian
reader_toolbar_style_hint: Floating toolbars hover over the page and hide with a tap; docked bars span the full width.
reader_toolbars_hide_ball_off: Bola mengambang dalam aplikasi nonaktif, jadi bilah tetap tampil
reader_toolbars_hide_subtitle: Bola mengambang mengambil alih: kembali, pengaturan, dan tombol untuk memunculkan bilah tetap ada di sana
reader_vn_merge_spoken_sentence: Pertahankan kalimat yang diucapkan dalam satu layar
reading_stats_clock_start_mode_hint: When the reading timer starts after you open a book (applies the next time a book is opened). You can pause or resume it anytime with the timer button or P.
reading_stats_idle_timeout_hint: Berhenti menghitung waktu membaca setelah sekian menit tanpa membalik halaman, menggulir, atau mencari kata. Hanya untuk novel, PDF, dan manga; video dihitung selama diputar.
rematch_adjust_window: Sesuaikan jendela pencarian dan cocokkan ulang
remote_book_audiobook_download_failed: Tidak dapat mengunduh buku audio untuk buku ini
remote_book_delete_everywhere_confirm: Delete "$name" on host "$host"? Its files, reading progress, bookmarks and audiobook there are removed for good, and this device has no copy. This cannot be undone.
remote_book_download_failed: Tidak dapat mengunduh buku jarak jauh
remote_book_hidden_message: Removed from this device's shelf. The copy on the server is untouched.
remote_book_list_failed: Tidak bisa mengambil perpustakaan jarak jauh dari perangkat pasangan.
remote_book_subtitles_audio_mismatch: The peer's audio files differ from this device's. Use Re-download audiobook instead
remote_book_subtitles_refresh_failed: Couldn't update subtitles. If the peer runs an older Fushi, use Re-download audiobook instead
remote_collection_download_nothing: Tidak ada episode jarak jauh untuk diunduh
remote_collection_download_started: Mengunduh $count episode jarak jauh di latar belakang
remote_collection_scrape_failed: Scrape jarak jauh gagal: karya tidak ada dalam rencana pustaka host
remote_collection_scrape_identity_confli: Host sudah mengikat karya ini ke ID $provider $id. Ganti?
remote_collection_scrape_push_to_host: Scrape di sini dan kirim ke host
remote_collection_scrape_unavailable: Scraping jarak jauh tidak tersedia untuk host ini
remote_delete_audiobook_partial: Buku dihapus, tetapi buku audionya tidak bisa dihapus di perangkat pasangan
remote_delete_failed: Tidak bisa menghapus di perangkat pasangan
remote_delete_unsupported: Perangkat pasangan terlalu lama untuk mendukung penghapusan jarak jauh. Perbarui Fushi di sana terlebih dahulu.
remote_dict_lookup_hint: Ketika kamus lokal tidak menemukan hasil, kueri ke server Fushi yang dikonfigurasi
remote_hidden_books_empty_message: When you pick "Remove from this device only" on a remote book, it shows up here so you can bring it back.
remote_hidden_books_hint: Bring back remote books you removed from this device's shelf
remote_hidden_books_hint_count: ${n} removed · Bring back remote books you removed from this device's shelf
remote_hidden_books_title: Remote books removed from this device
remote_manga_added_to_shelf: Ditambahkan ke rak manga; bab diunduh dari peer
remote_video_download_failed: Tidak dapat mengunduh video jarak jauh
remote_video_list_failed: Tidak bisa memuat video remote. Pastikan perangkat lain online dan di jaringan yang sama, lalu coba lagi.
reverse_arrow_page_turn: Balik arah ganti halaman kiri/kanan keyboard
scan_non_japanese_text_hint: Saat mati, seleksi berhenti di karakter non-Jepang
scrape_all_confirm: Cocokkan semua $n item perpustakaan berdasarkan judul. Hanya kecocokan kepercayaan tinggi yang diterapkan secara otomatis — video dinilai dari judul bersama tahun, tipe, dan sinyal lainnya, sementara buku dan game memerlukan kecocokan judul persis yang unik. Sampul yang Anda pilih sendiri tidak pernah ditimpa (gambar lokal yang Anda atur, entri yang Anda pilih di dialog pencocokan, dan file poster yang ditempatkan di folder), dan hasil yang ambigu tetap menunggu untuk ditinjau manual.
scrape_all_done: Selesai: $applied diterapkan, $review perlu ditinjau, $skipped dilewati, $failed gagal
scrape_all_empty: Tidak ada item untuk di-scrape di perpustakaan ini.
scrape_reason_network: Tidak bisa mendapatkan respons yang valid dari sumber sampul. Periksa jaringan Anda dan coba lagi.
scrape_reason_server: Sumber sampul mengembalikan error. Coba lagi nanti atau pilih kandidat lain.
screen_ocr_card_image_hint: When mining from Screen OCR or camera lookup, put the text block you tapped (with a little margin) into the card's picture field. Sharpness follows the card image quality setting
screen_ocr_keep_session_hint: After you allow screen capture once, Screen OCR stops asking every time. A notification stays while the session is kept; it ends when you tap Stop or the system ends the sharing, and the next Screen OCR asks again
screen_ocr_session_hint: Screen OCR won't ask for permission again until you tap Stop or the system ends the sharing
screen_ocr_session_notification: Screen capture session kept for Screen OCR
section_tabs_order_hint: Drag, or use the arrows. Tabs added later go to the end.
section_video_subtitles_footer: The preview follows your current subtitle settings. While a video plays, you can also adjust them live from the player's settings.
selection_web_search_unavailable: Tidak ada aplikasi yang dapat mencari di web.
settings_content_language_description: Bahasa fallback untuk konten yang tidak mendeklarasikan bahasanya. Pengaturan per-buku, per-video, per-game, dan per-kamus menimpa ini.
settings_destination_models_summary: LLM, OCR, speech recognition, speech synthesis and model files
settings_destination_services_summary: API pihak ketiga, pengindeks, dan server media
settings_downloads_advanced_hint: Koneksi, memori, penemuan peer, dan perlindungan
settings_downloads_open_page_hint: Buka halaman Unduhan (tugas, sumber daya, langganan)
settings_downloads_routing_hint: Pemetaan jalur dan sumber video tujuan
settings_lookup_ime_language_description: Bahasa yang dipilih papan ketik saat Anda mengetik di kotak pencarian. Metode input harus sudah terpasang di sistem. Tidak memengaruhi hasil pencarian.
settings_lookup_ime_language_unavailable: Metode input itu belum terpasang di sistem ini.
settings_module_keep_one_navigation: Keep at least one page in the navigation bar
settings_module_nav_settings_always_on: Always shown, can't be turned off
settings_page_reset_all_default: Everything on this page is at its default
settings_page_reset_message: Checked settings will go back to their defaults.
settings_search_empty_hint: Try a shorter word or a synonym
settings_services_link_subtitle: Jimaku, OpenSubtitles, Torznab, Jellyfin, AniDB, dan TMDB dikonfigurasi bersama di sini
settings_study_diag_export_hint: Kredit halaman, buka/tutup segmen, jejak lanjut dan lompat buku audio, untuk memecahkan anomali kecepatan membaca. Disimpan sebagai file teks.
settings_video_diag_export_hint: Linimasa plus log verbose libmpv sendiri
settings_video_diag_toggle_hint: Mencatat waktu frame, statistik pemutaran libmpv, dan waktu pencarian per tahap. Mati secara default; aktifkan, reproduksi tersendat atau pencarian lambat, lalu ekspor.
shortcut_action_audiobook_seek_clicked: Lompat audio ke kalimat yang diklik
shortcut_action_global_external_open_loo: Bawa ke depan dan buka halaman pencarian
shortcut_conflict_keep_both_hint: Kedua aksi mempertahankan pengikatan ini. Cakupan mana yang teratasi lebih dulu menang saat ditekan.
shortcut_conflict_replace_confirm: Pintasan ini sudah dipakai oleh $s. Pindahkan ke tindakan ini?
shortcut_gamepad_unavailable_hint: Komponen GameInput tidak terdeteksi — dukungan gamepad tidak tersedia. Instal Windows Gaming Services untuk mengaktifkan dukungan kontroler.
shortcut_lookup_page_escape_minimize: Tombol kembali di halaman pencarian meminimalkan jendela
shortcut_lookup_page_escape_minimize_hin: Setelah hotkey bawa ke depan, tekan tombol kembali (Esc secara default) di halaman pencarian untuk menyingkirkan jendela dan kembali ke yang sedang Anda lakukan. Kueri dan hasil dipertahankan.
shortcut_mouse_button_not_supported: Aksi ini hanya menerima tombol samping mouse (mundur/maju).
shortcut_press_wheel: Tahan tombol modifier dan gulir di sini
shortcut_record_mouse_prompt: Press a mouse button here, or scroll while holding a modifier
shortcut_record_prompt: Press the new shortcut… Esc cancels
shortcut_reset_all_confirm: Restore every shortcut to its default?
shortcut_reset_confirm: Kembalikan semua pintasan di bagian ini ke default?
shortcut_scope_dictionary_popup_note: Berfungsi saat pointer berada di atas popup kamus
shortcut_scope_global_external_desktop_n: Pemicu mouse hanya menerima tombol samping (mundur/maju). Tombol lain mempertahankan fungsi normalnya di aplikasi lain, sehingga ditolak di sini.
shortcut_scope_global_external_mobile_no: Triggered by the system (text selection menu, share, floating ball); the OS does not allow apps to remap this hotkey.
shortcut_search_by_key: Look up by pressing a key
shortcut_search_by_key_prompt: Press the key or button to look up…
shortcut_wheel_needs_modifier: Roda tanpa modifier menggulir popup — tahan Alt / Ctrl / Shift sambil menggulir
show_media_notification_hint: When off, a minimal notification (title and play/pause only) stays during playback so the system doesn't stop audio in the background.
srs_action_failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
srs_anki_migrate_android_hint: AnkiDroid 2.17 and later keep the collection in private storage other apps can't read. In AnkiDroid choose Export → Collection package (.colpkg), include scheduling and media, then pick that file here.
srs_anki_migrate_confirm_body: $notes notes, $cards cards and $reviews reviews will be imported together with their scheduling, note types and media. Your existing Fushi data is kept, and migrating again won't create duplicates.
srs_anki_migrate_confirm_file: “$name” will be imported together with its scheduling, note types and media. Your existing Fushi data is kept, and migrating again won't create duplicates.
srs_anki_migrate_desktop_hint: Close Anki before migrating. Fushi reads a copy of your collection and leaves Anki untouched.
srs_anki_migrate_error_changed: Anki changed the collection while it was being read. Close Anki and try again.
srs_anki_migrate_error_corrupt: This collection can't be read (it's damaged or not an Anki collection).
srs_anki_migrate_error_locked: Couldn't read the collection. Close Anki and try again.
srs_anki_migrate_error_missing: The collection is no longer there. Scan again.
srs_anki_migrate_grant_access: Allow file access to find AnkiDroid
srs_anki_migrate_hint: Move your whole Anki / AnkiDroid collection here, review history included
srs_anki_migrate_intro: Bring your decks, notes, note types, review progress and media over from Anki in one go. Your Anki data is only read, never changed.
srs_anki_migrate_ios_hint: In AnkiMobile or Anki, export a collection package (.colpkg) with scheduling and media, save it to Files, then pick it here.
srs_anki_migrate_no_collection_in_folder: No collection.anki2 in that folder or its subfolders.
srs_anki_migrate_none_found: No Anki collection found on this device.
srs_anki_migrate_open_warning: Anki seems to be open. Close it (or sync) first so the latest reviews come along.
srs_anki_migrate_scope: Carried over: decks, notes, note types and templates, card scheduling, review history, deck options and media. Not carried over: add-ons, filtered decks (their cards go back to their home deck) and Anki's own preferences.
srs_anki_migrate_setup_algorithm_fsrs_de: Keep FSRS as in Anki, with your trained parameters when you migrate them. Decks without parameters use FSRS-7, optimized from your reviews.
srs_anki_migrate_setup_algorithm_rwkv_de: RWKV is Fushi's default. It predicts memory from your whole review history and needs no trained parameters. Your FSRS parameters are kept, and you can switch any deck back to FSRS in its settings.
srs_anki_migrate_setup_convert_lapis: Convert old Lapis notes to Fushi card
srs_anki_migrate_setup_convert_lapis_des: Fushi card is the successor of the Lapis template. Fields are mapped by meaning and review history moves with the cards; field content with no place in the new template stays on the note. Applies to every Lapis note on this device, including the ones imported now. You can also do this later from Note types.
srs_anki_migrate_setup_notice_background: Migration runs in the background, so you can leave this page. Progress and the full report appear in the task bar at the top of the deck list.
srs_anki_migrate_setup_notice_backup: To undo a migration, open Backups and use Restore to this point on a backup made before it.
srs_anki_migrate_setup_notice_merge: Migration merges into Fushi: existing cards are kept and nothing in Anki is changed. Migrating again does not create duplicates.
srs_anki_migrate_setup_notice_restore: Notes you imported before and later deleted in Fushi are restored, and their cards return to their original decks.
srs_anki_migrate_setup_rename_lapis_deck: Rename Lapis decks to Fushi Card

Replaces "Lapis" in deck names with "Fushi Card" (e.g. Lapis::Mining becomes Fushi Card::Mining). Covers every deck on this device; a deck whose new name already exists next to it is left as is. Only applies when converting old Lapis notes.
srs_anki_migrate_setup_switch_target: Send new cards to Fushi Review
srs_anki_migrate_setup_switch_target_des: After migrating, mined cards go to Fushi Review instead of Anki, and "Mine to Fushi Interconnect server" is turned off. Cards reach your other devices through review sync.
srs_ankiconnect_hint: With the review module on, AnkiConnect tools (Yomitan, asbplayer and others) can use http://127.0.0.1:$port as their AnkiConnect address to add cards straight to Fushi review.
srs_browse_delete_confirm: Delete $n notes and all of their cards?
srs_browse_help_days: Added or edited in the last N days
srs_browse_help_deck: In the deck or its subdecks
srs_browse_help_field: The field matches exactly; * matches any text, _ one character
srs_browse_help_flag: Flag: 0 none, 1–7 red, orange, green, blue, pink, turquoise, purple
srs_browse_help_prop: Properties: ivl interval, due days until due, reps, lapses, s stability, d difficulty (0–1); compare with = != < > <= >=
srs_browse_help_tag: Has the tag or a child tag; tag:none means no tags
srs_browse_preview_empty: Select a card to preview it
srs_browse_reset_confirm: Forget the progress of $n cards and treat them as new? You can undo right after.
srs_browse_set_due_hint: Days from today: 0 is today, 3 is in 3 days, 1-7 spreads cards over 1 to 7 days
srs_browse_set_due_invalid: Enter a number of days, or a range like 1-7
srs_browse_undo_partial: $n cards were already reviewed on another device and could not be undone
srs_card_appearance_compact_phone: Compact back on phones (long definitions folded)
srs_card_appearance_design_skin_hint: Restyle imported and custom card templates (background, frames, text and link colors, fonts) in the app's Material or Apple style. The template's layout and content stay as designed. Off shows templates exactly as authored.
srs_card_appearance_dict_unified_hint: Recolor each dictionary's own colors to match the card (Material). Off keeps the original dictionary style.
srs_card_appearance_font_hint: From the font library; characters fall back in order (put Latin fonts first)
srs_card_appearance_hint: Applies to the Fushi Card note type
srs_card_reset_confirm: Forget this card's progress and treat it as new? You can undo right after.
srs_change_type_cloze_hint: Cards keep their number: card N becomes cloze N (or the N-th card type of the new type).
srs_change_type_confirm: Change the note type of $n notes? $dropped cards will be deleted.
srs_change_type_dropped: $n cards have no counterpart in the new type and will be deleted.
srs_change_type_fields_hint: Choose which current field fills each field of the new type.
srs_change_type_mixed: The selected notes have different note types. Select notes of one type.
srs_change_type_no_target: There is no other note type yet. Create one under Note types first.
srs_change_type_templates_hint: Choose which current card each new card type takes over. The card keeps its review history and schedule.
srs_conflict_deleted_while_edited: Deleted on another device while it was edited here (${n} changes)
srs_conflict_deleted_while_moved: Deleted on another device while it was moved
srs_conflict_deleted_while_reviewed: Deleted on another device while it was reviewed (${n} reviews)
srs_conflicts_deletions: Deleted on one device, changed on another
srs_conflicts_empty_hint: When two devices change the same setting at the same time, the replaced value shows up here so you can switch back.
srs_deck_delete_move_cards_hint: Move them to the parent deck (or the default deck)
srs_deck_delete_prompt: Delete "$name" and its subdecks. What should happen to their cards?
srs_deck_delete_purge_hint: Delete the deck, its cards and unused media now to free disk space. Review history is kept for statistics. This cannot be undone.
srs_deck_delete_with_cards_hint: Notes whose cards are all in these decks are deleted; notes that also have cards elsewhere keep them and their cards here move to the parent deck
srs_deck_move_drop_top_level: Drop here to move to the top level
srs_deck_move_into_own_subdeck: A deck can't go into its own subdeck
srs_deck_move_name_taken: A deck with the same name is already there
srs_deck_new_paused: Many reviews due today — no new cards today
srs_deck_new_reduced: Many reviews due today — new cards reduced to $n
srs_duplicates_hint: Same word and reading in the same note type, probably added on two devices. Merging keeps the selected note and combines the review history of all of them.
srs_duplicates_merged: Merged. Review history of ${n} cards was combined.
srs_empty_body: Add a note to the default deck and it shows up here for review. Cards you mine while reading can also go straight into review.
srs_engine_unavailable: The scheduling engine is not available on this device. You can browse and edit cards, but reviewing is disabled.
srs_export_anki_compatible_desc: Leave out Fushi-only data (full review log, FSRS-7 parameters, note sources). Anki ignores it either way; keep this off if you want to import the file back into Fushi without loss.
srs_export_fsrs7_note: Anki will schedule these cards with FSRS-6. After importing, run Optimize once in the deck options in Anki.
srs_export_with_deck_configs: Include deck presets and FSRS parameters
srs_export_with_deck_configs_desc: Learning steps, daily limits, desired retention and FSRS parameters. When off, decks use Anki's default preset.
srs_export_with_scheduling_desc: Review history and due dates. When off, every card is exported as new.
srs_field_info_ai_request: Only write a one-sentence description for the field "${name}" (what it holds and where it shows on the card). Do not change the layout.
srs_field_info_definition_picture_desc: A picture shown next to the definition; fill it yourself if you like.
srs_field_info_description_hint: What does this field hold, and where does it show? Shown wherever this field is listed.
srs_field_info_description_override_hint: Write your own to replace the built-in description
srs_field_info_example_from_catalog: No cards of this note type yet, so the example is a built-in sample.
srs_field_info_expression_audio_desc: Pronunciation audio of the word; shown as a play button.
srs_field_info_expression_desc: The word you are learning, as written. The front usually shows only this. Filled with the looked-up word when mining.
srs_field_info_expression_furigana_desc: The same word with readings in 漢字[かな] form; the card shows the kana above the kanji.
srs_field_info_expression_reading_desc: The kana reading of the word, e.g. たべる.
srs_field_info_freq_sort_desc: A single number (harmonic mean rank) for sorting by frequency; not shown directly.
srs_field_info_frequency_desc: Rankings from your frequency dictionaries; smaller means more common.
srs_field_info_glossary_desc: The full definitions from every dictionary, usually folded under the main definition.
srs_field_info_hint_desc: A small hint for the front, revealed when tapped.
srs_field_info_is_audio_card_desc: Type any character to turn it on: the front only plays audio, testing listening.
srs_field_info_is_click_card_desc: Type any character to turn it on: the front shows the sentence and the word is revealed on tap.
srs_field_info_is_sentence_card_desc: Type any character to turn it on: the front shows only the sentence, testing the whole sentence.
srs_field_info_is_word_and_sentence_card: Type any character (e.g. x) to turn it on: the front shows both the word and the sentence. On by default for cards mined in Fushi.
srs_field_info_main_definition_desc: The main definition (by default the first entry of the first dictionary).
srs_field_info_mining: When mining a card it is filled with: ${slot}
srs_field_info_mining_none: Not filled automatically when mining; fill it yourself in the note editor.
srs_field_info_misc_info_desc: Where the card came from: the work title (tap to jump back) and the timestamp.
srs_field_info_picture_desc: A screenshot or picture shown on the card to help you remember.
srs_field_info_pitch_categories_desc: Type names such as heiban / atamadaka / nakadaka / odaka, used to colour the reading.
srs_field_info_pitch_position_desc: The pitch accent position number (e.g. 0, 2); the template draws the pitch line from it and does not show it directly.
srs_field_info_selection_text_desc: The text you selected in the dictionary while looking up. When present, the card shows it instead of the whole definition.
srs_field_info_sentence_audio_desc: A recording of the sentence (from the video or audiobook); shown as a play button.
srs_field_info_sentence_desc: The sentence you met the word in; the word itself is bolded.
srs_field_info_sentence_furigana_desc: The sentence with readings in 漢字[かな] form. Usually left empty; fill it by hand when needed.
srs_field_info_sentence_translation_desc: A translation of the sentence (a Fushi card field; hidden when empty).
srs_field_info_templates_none: No card template shows this field yet.
srs_field_info_usage: How it is filled and used
srs_field_info_where_hint: The dashed box marks this field's content.
srs_field_kind_data: Data for the template, usually not shown
srs_field_kind_flag: Switch: any character turns it on, not shown itself
srs_history_import_confirm: Words you mined before (word, reading, definition, sentence) will be added to the default deck of the current profile "$profile". Words already imported are skipped.
srs_history_import_hint: Cards you mined in Fushi before (word, reading, definition, sentence)
srs_import_background_started: Importing in the background. You can keep using Fushi.
srs_import_colpkg_note: This is a whole-collection package. Anki would replace its entire collection with it; Fushi merges it instead and never deletes or replaces the cards you already have.
srs_import_file_hint: Shared decks, or decks exported from Anki
srs_import_merge_notetypes_help: When a note type in the package has different fields or card templates than the same note type here, merge them into one: fields and templates added in the package are added here, and nothing here is removed. When off, the package's version is imported as a separate note type, and notes that already exist under the note type here are not updated.
srs_import_needs_kernel: This package uses Anki's newer format, which needs the scheduling engine. The engine isn't available on this device.
srs_import_report_conflicts: $n notes were not imported because their note type conflicts
srs_import_report_default_algorithm: Preset "$preset" had no FSRS parameters in Anki (SM-2 or never optimized), so its decks use Fushi's default, RWKV
srs_import_report_default_fsrs: Preset "$preset" had no FSRS parameters in Anki (SM-2 or never optimized), so its decks use FSRS-7 with default parameters
srs_import_report_fsrs: Preset "$preset" came with $alg parameters; its decks now use Fushi's default, RWKV, which queues reviews by how well you remember each card right now. The $alg parameters are kept: to stay on $alg, choose Keep FSRS below or switch back in deck settings › Algorithm
srs_import_report_future: $n cards have times in the future and were imported without their schedule
srs_import_report_invalid_params: Preset "$preset": its parameters were invalid and were not imported
srs_import_report_lapis_failed: Converting old Lapis notes to Fushi card failed. The import itself is complete; you can retry from Note types.
srs_import_report_media_missing: $n referenced media files are missing from the package
srs_import_report_notetypes_duplicated: Note type “$name” differs from the one here and was imported as a separate note type
srs_import_report_presets_skipped: Deck presets not imported: $n (new decks use the default settings)
srs_import_report_removed: $n fields or templates deleted in the source are kept here
srs_import_report_reset_new: Imported as new cards without review progress: $n
srs_import_report_rwkv: Preset "$preset" used RWKV in Anki and keeps using it
srs_import_report_rwkv_on_fsrs: Preset "$preset" used RWKV in Anki; RWKV was off for this import, so its decks use FSRS-7
srs_import_report_steps_removed: Deck "$preset": steps $removed were removed and are now scheduled by FSRS
srs_import_task_stopping: Stopping import of $name… (already imported notes are kept)
srs_import_update_notes_help: When a note already exists here: “If newer” updates it only if it was changed in the package after your last change here; “Always” always takes the content from the package; “Never” keeps what you have.
srs_import_update_notetypes_help: The same choice for note types: their name, styling and card templates.
srs_import_use_rwkv_help: Decks created by this import use RWKV, Fushi's default scheduler. FSRS parameters imported from the package are kept, so you can switch back later. When off, decks keep the package's FSRS algorithm (FSRS-7 if it has none or FSRS parameters aren't imported, including presets that used RWKV in Anki).
srs_import_with_deck_configs_help: Decks created by this import take the learning steps, daily limits, maximum interval and audio settings from the package. When off they use the default settings. The algorithm and FSRS parameters have their own switch. Decks that already exist are never changed.
srs_import_with_fsrs_params_help: Decks created by this import take the FSRS parameters and desired retention from the package, plus its FSRS algorithm when RWKV is off. When off they use Fushi's defaults (RWKV, or FSRS-7 optimized automatically from your reviews when RWKV is off). Decks that already exist are never changed.
srs_import_with_scheduling_help: Imports review history, due dates and suspended state. When off, every card is imported as a new card, no review history is imported, and the marked / leech tags are removed. Turn it on when importing your own backup; leave it off for decks shared by others.
srs_lapis_migration_backfill_summary: $n migrated notes have empty fields whose pre-migration content still exists. Only empty fields are filled; existing content is never overwritten.
srs_lapis_migration_backfill_title: Fill fields missed by earlier migrations
srs_lapis_migration_cards: $linked cards keep their review history, $dropped cards no longer appear
srs_lapis_migration_confirm: Migrate $n notes of “$name” to Fushi Card?
srs_lapis_migration_entry_summary: $n notes can be migrated or have missed fields
srs_lapis_migration_fallback: $n notes fill an empty field from another field with the same meaning
srs_lapis_migration_intro: Old Lapis note types (built-in, imported from Anki, or renamed) move to Fushi Card. Fields map by meaning, review history moves with the cards, and nothing is written until you confirm.
srs_lapis_migration_lost: No matching field in Fushi Card (content stays on the note, not migrated): $fields
srs_lapis_migration_nothing: Nothing to migrate: no old Lapis notes and no missed fields.
srs_lapis_migration_reminder_title: Migrate old Lapis notes to Fushi Card
srs_migrate_fushi_confirm: Migrate $n Lapis notes to Fushi Card? Fields map by name and review history moves with the cards.
srs_migrate_fushi_not_lapis: Only Lapis notes can be migrated
srs_mining_builtin_mapping_hint: Built-in note types use their built-in field mapping.
srs_mining_deck_fallback: The selected deck was deleted; cards go to the default deck.
srs_mining_note_type_fallback: The selected note type was deleted; cards use Lapis.
srs_mining_required_unmapped: Required fields are not mapped: $fields. Cards mined now would be empty (a card whose first field is empty is refused).
srs_mining_target_hint: Where a card goes when you mine a word
srs_module_switch_hint: Fushi's built-in spaced repetition: decks, FSRS-7 scheduling, review on any device
srs_note_delete_confirm: Delete this note and all of its cards?
srs_note_delete_conflict: Deleted on one device while edited on another.
srs_note_field_ai_custom_hint: Tell the AI what to write
srs_note_field_conflict: Changed on two devices at once — pick the value to keep:
srs_note_field_edit_text_empty: No editable text in this field
srs_note_field_structured_hint: Formatted dictionary content. Edit the HTML source to change it
srs_note_field_structured_wysiwyg_hint: Dictionary layout: tap Edit text to change the words right inside the layout; switch to source to change the structure
srs_note_format_ruby_select_hint: Select the text to annotate first
srs_note_format_ruby_single_line: A reading can't span multiple lines
srs_note_furigana_hint: Tap a word to change its reading
srs_note_types_builtin_hint: Built-in note types can be edited but not deleted. Mining and the review marks in the lookup popup rely on their built-in fields, so those fields can be renamed or reordered but not deleted.
srs_note_types_conflict: Another device changed this note type at the same time. Pick the version to keep:
srs_note_types_delete_confirm: Delete "$name"? Its $n notes and their cards will be deleted too.
srs_note_types_discard_body: Your changes to this card type haven't been saved.
srs_note_types_field_delete_confirm: Delete the field "$name"? $n notes have content in it, and that content will be lost.
srs_note_types_field_last: A note type needs at least one field
srs_note_types_fields_hint: What each note holds; open a field to see where it shows on the card
srs_note_types_flag_fields_hint: Put any character in one to turn that card style on
srs_note_types_name_invalid: Field names can't contain : { } " or start with # /
srs_note_types_name_reserved: This name is reserved by Anki (FrontSide, Tags, Deck…)
srs_note_types_preview_empty: The front is empty for this note, so this card won't be shown.
srs_note_types_preview_placeholder: No notes yet. The preview fills each field with its name.
srs_note_types_styling_hint: Shared by all card types of this note type
srs_note_types_template_cloze_single: Cloze note types have exactly one card type
srs_note_types_template_delete_confirm: Delete the card type "$name"? $n cards made from it will be deleted.
srs_note_types_template_last: A note type needs at least one card type
srs_note_types_templates_hint: Each template makes one card; open one to change its layout
srs_note_types_term_field_hint: Review marks in the lookup popup match words against this field
srs_review_hide_hard_easy_hint: Keys 2 and 4 still rate Hard and Easy
srs_review_layout_floating_top_bar_hint: Hidden by default. Tap a blank spot on the card or right-click to show it, and again to hide it.
srs_review_layout_image_size_hint: Enlarge images that the deck styles keep small; tap an image to view it full screen
srs_review_layout_replay_button_hint: Within thumb reach when reviewing on a phone; the top bar keeps its replay
srs_review_layout_show_counts_hint: New · learning · review counts under the deck name
srs_review_layout_show_intervals: Show next interval on rating buttons
srs_review_layout_show_intervals_hint: A small label under each rating, so a mis-tap or an odd schedule stands out
srs_review_layout_volume_hint: Volume of card audio, both when tapped and when played automatically
srs_review_rwkv_unavailable: RWKV is not ready yet, so this deck follows the due dates stored by FSRS-7.
srs_review_undo_blocked: This card was already reviewed on another device, so this step can't be undone
srs_settings_algorithm_hint: A new algorithm applies from the next review; due dates already scheduled stay as they are. Use Reschedule deck now to apply it right away.
srs_settings_algorithm_unknown: This deck uses an algorithm from a newer version; this device uses $alg for now
srs_settings_auto_optimize_hint: Fit the scheduling parameters to your own review history from time to time
srs_settings_auto_optimize_rwkv_hint: For RWKV decks this fits the FSRS-7 parameters running underneath. They set the intervals shown on the answer buttons, the stored due dates (used for queueing while RWKV isn't ready) and the due dates exported to Anki. Runs by itself while the app is idle; there's no need to press Optimize now.
srs_settings_autoplay_audio_hint: Play the card's audio when the question or the answer is shown. The answer side skips audio carried over from the front.
srs_settings_children_inherit_confirm: Switch the $n sub-decks under this deck that have their own settings to "Same as parent"? Their target retention, algorithm, parameters and automatic optimization will then follow this deck. Their own steps and daily limits stay as they are.
srs_settings_children_inherit_hint: Some sub-decks below have their own scheduling settings (common after importing from Anki), so changes made here don't reach them.
srs_settings_conflict_replaced: Replaced by a change from another device
srs_settings_max_interval_hint: No card is scheduled further out than this
srs_settings_new_per_day_hint: When many reviews are due, Fushi automatically shows fewer new cards
srs_settings_optimize_kept: The current parameters already fit best; nothing changed
srs_settings_optimize_never: Not optimized yet; using the default parameters
srs_settings_optimize_not_enough: Not enough review history to optimize yet
srs_settings_replay_question_audio: Include question audio when replaying answer
srs_settings_replay_question_audio_hint: When off, Replay audio on the answer side plays only the answer's audio.
srs_settings_reschedule_confirm: Recompute the due dates of every review card in this deck with the current settings?
srs_settings_reset_params_confirm: Use the default scheduling parameters for this deck? Automatic optimization waits until you have more reviews.
srs_settings_retention_hint: The chance you still remember a card when it comes due. Higher means more reviews.
srs_settings_rwkv_failed: RWKV is unavailable: $error. Reviews follow the due dates stored by FSRS-7 until this is fixed.
srs_settings_rwkv_hint: RWKV estimates each card's recall right now from your whole review history with a neural network; a review card is shown once its estimated recall drops to the desired retention, whatever its due date. Stability, difficulty and the stored due date are still tracked with FSRS-7.
srs_settings_rwkv_min_reviews_hint: If fewer cards than this have been reviewed in this deck today, top up with the cards RWKV is least sure you remember, even above the desired retention. 0 turns it off.
srs_settings_rwkv_rebuild_hint: Replays your whole review history again. RWKV keeps itself up to date otherwise; this is only needed after moving cards to another deck or changing how a deck inherits its settings.
srs_settings_rwkv_refresh_every: Update the RWKV queue every N answers
srs_settings_rwkv_refresh_every_hint: How many answers to wait between full RWKV score updates. 1 updates after every answer (in the background, used from the next card). Higher values reduce the work RWKV does while you review, but the queue may use older estimates between updates.
srs_settings_rwkv_repeat_hint: A card answered today comes back only after both: this many answers to other cards in these decks, and this many seconds.
srs_settings_rwkv_retention_note: RWKV's recall estimate starts near your overall pass rate rather than at 100%: a desired retention above that rate brings cards back almost right away, and one well below it shows few reviews.
srs_settings_steps_hint: Separate with spaces, e.g. 1 10; each step must be shorter than a day
srs_settings_steps_invalid: Enter positive numbers of minutes, each shorter than one day
srs_starter_already_added: This deck is already in your decks
srs_starter_body: Starter decks download from their authors' release pages and import like any .apkg.
srs_stats_empty: No review history yet. Review a few cards and your statistics show up here.
srs_stats_future_due_by_recall: $n review cards in RWKV decks aren't counted: they come back when their estimated recall drops to the desired retention, not on a due date.
srs_stats_memory_empty: Nothing to show yet: review some cards first.
srs_stats_retention_hint: How often you remembered review cards when they came due. FSRS schedules for the desired retention; the closer the two, the better the parameters fit you.
srs_stats_retrievability_unavailable: The scheduling engine is not available on this device, so retrievability cannot be computed.
srs_stats_unavailable: Turn on the review module to see review statistics.
srs_sync_awaiting_confirm: Review data will sync after you confirm on the review page
srs_sync_backend_unsupported: The current sync service doesn't support syncing review data
srs_sync_clock_skew: Your system clock is off by more than 10 minutes. Review times follow the sync server instead.
srs_sync_confirm_body: The first sync combines the review data on all your devices: notes and reviews from every device are kept, nothing is overwritten. If the same word was added on two devices, Sync conflicts will offer to merge them.
srs_sync_directory_unidentified: The sync folder can't be identified yet (account or address not ready)
srs_sync_location_meta_unavailable: The location's settings file can't be read right now; it will be retried next time.
srs_sync_no_backend: No sync service is set up
srs_sync_profile_not_linked: Another device's profile "$name" in the sync folder also has notes, so it couldn't be linked automatically. Review data isn't shared between them.
srs_sync_setup_body: Review data syncs along with cloud sync (Sync & backup) and Fushi Interconnect; there is no separate switch. Neither is set up on this device yet.
srs_sync_store_unavailable: SRS data isn't open on this device right now
srs_timeline_checkpoint_failed: Could not add a restore point
srs_timeline_checkpoints_empty_hint: One is added automatically before bulk deletes, imports, note type changes, new FSRS parameters and restores.
srs_timeline_cloud_hint: Review data syncs along with your cloud drive (Sync & backup) or Fushi Interconnect. Every change is kept in the history below, so there is nothing to back up by hand.
srs_timeline_digest_mismatch: Data differs from this device at the same point. Please report this.
srs_timeline_import_confirm: Changes in the file are merged into this profile. Nothing here is overwritten.
srs_timeline_import_invalid: This is not a Fushi review export, or it was made by a newer version
srs_timeline_import_other_profile: This file belongs to another profile
srs_timeline_location_add_hint: A USB drive, a NAS, or a folder another sync tool keeps in sync
srs_timeline_location_bad_kdf: This location's encryption parameters are invalid. Sync is paused.
srs_timeline_location_encrypt_body: Review data and media in this location are encrypted with a passphrase; the storage only sees ciphertext and file sizes. Every device syncing here needs the same passphrase. If you forget it, this location cannot be read, but each device still has all its data. Encryption cannot be turned off here later.
srs_timeline_location_encrypt_done: Encryption is on for this location
srs_timeline_location_encrypt_pending: Encryption turns on at the next sync
srs_timeline_location_encrypted_hint: This location is end-to-end encrypted. Other devices need the same passphrase to sync here.
